summary: Big Digital Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the acceleration of its shareholder rights plan (poison pill) expiration to June 8, 2026, and filing of a Certificate of Amendment to its Certificate of Incorporation in connection with the termination. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is described. The filing is a routine update regarding a rights agreement termination and corporate housekeeping, not a special situation.
